install.cardTitle: Get Meen Fina on your home screen
install.cardBody: Opens full screen like a normal app, and lets you get notifications.

ios.step1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow).
ios.step2: Scroll and tap "Add to Home Screen", then "Add".
ios.step3: Open Meen Fina from your home screen and sign in.

android.step1: Tap the ⋮ menu in your browser.
android.step2: Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
android.step3: Open Meen Fina from your home screen.
